params.description: The resource instance key or id to filter by (supports multi-value like this url?search=key-1&search=key-2)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number of the results to fetch, starting at 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: The number of results per page (max 100).

Creates a new instance inside the Permit.io system.

If the instance is already created: will return 200 instead of 201,
and will return the existing instance object in the response body.
